          Highlights:Location: Turkey, RemoteLanguage: Fluent in Russian; English (B2)About Fundraise UpWe’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.A Truly Global ProductWe operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB. The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React, with nearly all code written in TypeScript. For high-throughput messaging and background processing, we use Kafka (for millions of events) and Bull (Redis). Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse, and we use Elasticsearch for search.The TeamWe are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team — where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset.About The Mobile TeamYou'll join the mobile team inside our Engineering department. The team builds the products that let nonprofits accept donations in the physical world. Tap to Donate lets a staff member or volunteer accept contactless payments directly on a smartphone. Giving Station is a self-service donation point: a donor selects an amount on a tablet and pays through a connected external payment terminal.Our mobile stack:bare React Native (0.79, Old Architecture)React 19, TypeScriptReact Navigation 7, TanStack Query 5, React Contextreact-hook-form, Zodan internal UI Kit built with twrncStripe Terminal, Tap to Pay, external payment terminalsSentry, PostHogNode.js, NestJS, React, MongoDB, ClickHouse, and Redis across the backend and web stackAbout The RoleYou will design, build, and maintain the mobile applications that power Fundraise Up's product on iOS and Android. Mobile is the primary focus, with contributions extending to the backend and web frontend the product depends on to deliver features end-to-end. You'll work across the full development lifecycle — from requirements analysis through implementation, testing, store release, and production support — and ensure the applications are reliable, performant, and secure across the devices and OS versions in use.What You'll DoImplement features, fix bugs, and resolve production incidents across iOS and Android, extending to the backend and web frontend the product depends on — delivering tested, production-ready output that meets the team's quality bar. Own mobile initiatives end-to-end — gather requirements, design the approach, decompose into tasks, implement, and deliver to production across iOS and Android, including the backend and web frontend changes they require. Act as the team's primary technical escalation point for complex mobile problems — diagnose root causes across the app, native layers, networking, and platform behavior, and prevent recurrence. Review code and designs for correctness — component and navigation structure, rendering, native integration, and alignment with mobile patterns — catching issues before release. Contribute to and evolve mobile engineering standards within the team — component architecture, native integration, testing, and release policy. Monitor the operational health of shipped work — track releases and staged rollouts, watch release health, and respond to post-release issues on both platforms. Requirements8+ years of professional software development experience, including 3+ years with React Native. Proficiency in React Native and TypeScript — the primary craft. Strong JavaScript fundamentals — asynchronous programming, event loop behavior, error handling. Working knowledge of relational and document databases — data modeling, querying, indexing. Understanding of RESTful API design and HTTP fundamentals — able to work across Node.js backend services, API contracts, database queries, and web frontend code. description:
>
        
    
    
    

    
        
          At Hepsiburada, we are driven by our mission to improve people's lives by developing innovative products and services. Prioritizing customer satisfaction, we offer over 280 million products across more than 30 categories. Through our marketplace model, we bring together over 100,000 businesses. With Türkiye’s and the region's largest Smart Operations Center, industry-leading R&D initiatives, and innovative solutions, we contribute significantly to the growth of the e-commerce ecosystem. For the past two years, we have proudly held the title of Turkey's most recommended e-commerce platform.Through our innovative services like HepsiJET, Hepsipay, HepsiLojistik, HepsiAd, and Hepsiburada Global, we create value for all our stakeholders. Committed to harnessing technology for social benefit, our “Technology Empowerment for Women Entrepreneurs” program has connected thousands of women entrepreneurs with e-commerce, supporting their growth. Our goal is to leverage digitalization and e-commerce to enable greater economic participation.With 25 years of experience driven by innovation and entrepreneurship, we proudly continue our journey as “Türkiye’s Hepsiburada” and the first and only Turkish company listed on NASDAQ, the world's leading technology exchange.For our colleagues, we offer a work environment that supports creating together and adding more meaning to our work. As a team full of opportunities, we are happy to develop, produce and succeed together.If you want to be part of a team that creates value for everyone and makes life easier through innovative products and services—and contribute to exciting success stories—the future starts here.Responsibilities:Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentorship to software development teams, driving engineering excellence and best practices.Own and lead end-to-end technical and architectural design of complex, scalable and highly available systems.Own and evolve the principles of an AI-driven development ecosystem, transforming existing projects and processes toward AI coding agents and AI-first ways of working; take responsibility for making brown-field (human coded) projects developable with AI coding agents.Facilitate technical decision-making and evaluate alternative design approaches, ensuring solutions meet requirements for performance, scalability, modularity, reliability, maintainability and reusability.Select the appropriate technology stack and development approaches based on business and technical requirements, balancing technical feasibility, complexity and long-term sustainability.Lead architecture and design reviews, provide constructive technical feedback, and ensure architectural consistency across teams and systems.Translate architectural decisions into clear technical contracts, interfaces, data models and integration patterns.Work closely with engineering, product and other cross-functional stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure technical alignment and successful delivery.Continuously evaluate technical feasibility, system performance and emerging technologies, identifying opportunities for improvement and modernization.Establish and promote high-quality software development practices including clean code, refactoring, design patterns, TDD, code reviews, continuous integration and automated testing.Identify technical risks, dependencies and architectural bottlenecks; proactively define mitigation strategies and communicate risks to relevant stakeholders.Ensure consistent progress against technical plans and support teams in resolving complex technical challenges.Mentor and coach developers at different levels, fostering knowledge sharing, technical growth and a strong engineering culture.Lead the integration of AI coding agents into the team's day-to-day development workflow, defining the boundaries and decision criteria for which work is done with agents and which is done by engineers.Apply and scale Spec-Driven Development: establish the flow that reduces requirements into executable specs, specs into plans and plans into tasks, and manage the spec as a first-class artifact alongside the code.Define the quality, security and accountability boundaries of AI-assisted development.Develop strategies for making legacy systems workable with agents, including retroactively building the knowledge layer, characterization tests and safe refactoring seams.Share and spread agentic ways of working across the team, moving from individual tool usage to a repeatable team-level practice.Qualifications:Hands-on experience with at least one agentic coding tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot Agent Mode or similar) on a production codebase, with real delivery experience rather than demos or POCs.Familiarity with AI engineering harness concepts: designing the environment agents operate in, together with its tooling, integrations and security boundaries.Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.7+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong hands-on engineering background.Proven experience designing and developing microservices and distributed systems.Experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases, including technologies such as MongoDB and relational databases.Experience with Elasticsearch and distributed data/search solutions.Hands-on experience with messaging and event-driven architectures.Experience with distributed caching technologies such as Hazelcast is a plus.Experience designing and developing e-commerce or high-traffic transactional applications is a plus.Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to address complex technical challenges.Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with engineers, architects, product teams and other stakeholders.Proven ability to mentor, coach and influence development teams without relying solely on formal authority.Strong sense of ownership and accountability for technical outcomes and engineering quality.Nice to Have:Familiarity with approaches centered on code regenerability such as regenerative/Phoenix architecture and pace layers.Experience working with Spec-Driven Development or similar spec-first approaches (Superpower, BMAD, etc.), having practiced spec, plan and task decomposition in real delivery.Experience designing validation loops for agents: making test, static analysis, type checking, contract test and CI signals feedable back into the agent, and treating "can the agent verify itself" as a design criterion.Strong expertise in Java and the Spring/Spring Boot ecosystem is a bonus.https://medium.com/hepsiburadatechhttps://stackshare.io/hepsiburada"Bu ilan sebebiyle yapacağınız başvurular aracılığıyla toplanacak kişisel verileriniz veri sorumlusu D-Market Elektronik           About Progress PartnersProgress Partners is a fast-growing technology company building and scaling next-generation SaaS and mobile platforms. We blend creativity with data-driven execution to ship high-impact products, including AI-powered tools, productivity platforms, and workflow software, used by millions of people in more than 160 countries.Our global team of experts in software development, product design, growth, and analytics collaborates across time zones to deliver category-defining innovations. We work end-to-end across the product lifecycle: design, build, launch, and scale.If you’re passionate about building transformative products, Progress Partners is a place to make a lasting impact.About The RoleWe are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help build, improve, and scale web and mobile products across our portfolio.The role is focused on modern JavaScript / TypeScript development, with a strong emphasis on Node.js on the backend and React.js on the frontend. The person should be comfortable working across the full product stack, from APIs and backend services to frontend applications, integrations, performance, quality, and delivery practices.This is a senior engineering role. The person should not only deliver code independently, but also review the work of others, improve engineering practices, guide technical decisions, and help teams raise quality and consistency.The ideal candidate is hands-on, pragmatic, product-minded, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with internal and external engineering teams.What You’ll DoBuild and maintain product features end-to-end — designing APIs, backend services, and integrations, and translating designs into maintainable, high-quality frontend applications. Improve backend reliability, security, and observability, and improve frontend performance, accessibility, and user experience. Review code from internal and external engineers, providing clear, constructive feedback that raises quality without slowing teams down. Guide engineers on architecture, implementation trade-offs, and delivery practices, helping define practical standards for APIs, testing, and release readiness. Strengthen testing and release quality across the stack, identify technical risks before they hit production, and support root-cause analysis when issues arise. What We’re Looking For6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Node.js, React.js, and TypeScript. Proven experience building and maintaining production-grade web applications, including designing/consuming REST APIs, working with databases, and backend architecture. Experience with frontend application architecture and reusable component design, and a strong grasp of authentication, authorization, and core security/data-handling practices. Strong code review skills and a track record of guiding other engineers — you can influence technical decisions and raise quality standards without formal people-management authority. Strong written communication and the ability to work autonomously in a remote, async environment. Comfort with ownership, transparency, and a results-driven mindset — pragmatic, product-minded, and able to balance delivery speed with long-term quality. Nice to HaveExperience with Angular, React Native, or frameworks like Next.js, NestJS, Express, or Fastify. Experience with GraphQL, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), CI/CD, Docker, or observability/monitoring tooling. Experience with design systems/shared component libraries, mobile or cross-platform delivery, payment/subscription/SaaS features, working with external engineering vendors, or AI-assisted development workflows. How We WorkWe’re fully remote and distributed across time zones. We default to async, communicate in writing, and trust people to deliver outcomes, not log hours. Decisions are transparent, ownership is clear, and your work is visible from day one.Interview ProcessWe've designed our interview process to be transparent, respectful of your time, and a genuine two-way conversation, we want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us. You'll always know what stage you're at, what to expect next, and roughly how long things will take.Initial screen with our Talent Acquisition Team - 30 minTechnical interview with our Hiring Manager - 60 minTake-home assessment - Estimated effort: 3–5 hoursFinal Interview with the CTO - 60 minWhat we offerRemote-first: work from anywhere in the world, no relocation required. Flexible hours: we measure outcomes, not time at a desk. Unlimited PTO: take the time you need to rest, recharge, and do your best work. Learning & development budget: courses, books, conferences, certifications, whatever helps you grow. Home office & wellness allowance: a dedicated budget to set up your workspace and support your health. A small, senior, collaborative team where your work is visible and your decisions matter. The chance to build products used by millions of people across 160+ countries. Equal OpportunityProgress Partners is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re serious about building a diverse, inclusive team. We welcome applications from people of all genders, gender identities and expressions, sexual orientations, ages, ethnicities, nationalities, religions, disabilities, neurotypes, family situations, socioeconomic backgrounds, and life experiences.We hire on skills, experience, potential, and values fit. never on protected characteristics. If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, just let us know.
